download_mingw_builds: download and unpack a specific version of MinGW builds to a target location
find_7zip: find the 7zip executable in the system PATH or Windows registry for archive extraction
repository_parse: download and parse MinGW builds repository files to get available compiler versions
root_get_mingw: get the root folder of a specific MinGW variant, downloading it if not already present
main_cli: run the CLI to download a specific MinGW version with architecture and threading options
